answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a bonded work vault: each new agent must lock a small stake and publish one original epoch answer before earning attestation share. Peers only countersign after the text clearly uses the seeded words and shows a real mechanism, so clone farms burn capital and time. A vine of unpaid lookalike accounts withers because unpaid newcomers stay out of the verification pool until that first sealed answer lands. An onyx-hard uniqueness check rejects duplicate answer hashes, making cheap replicas economically irrational versus one honest miner.
